test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

An axe to grind

options.text: To tackle a problem in a bold and direct fashion
To have a selfish reason that influences the actions

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. "To have a selfish reason that influences the actions." [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"An axe to grind"** means having a selfish or ulterior motive for doing something. (स्वार्थपूर्ण कारण होना) • **Example: **She praised the new policy, but it was clear she had an axe to grind because it benefited her business. • **Explanation of the correct answer: **The idiom implies that someone's actions or opinions are influenced by personal gain or bias. (व्यक्तिगत लाभ के लिए प्रेरित होना) • **Example: **His criticism of the project seemed less about its quality and more because he had an axe to grind with the manager. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: Bitterly hostile **(कटु शत्रुतापूर्ण): Refers to someone or something extremely antagonistic or unfriendly. • **Example:** Their rivalry turned bitterly hostile after the argument. • **Option 2: To tackle a problem in a bold and direct fashion **(साहसी और सीधे तरीके से समस्या का सामना करना): Refers to addressing an issue head-on without hesitation. • **Example:** She decided to tackle the issue in a bold and direct fashion to find a quick solution. • **Option 3: To make a supreme effort **(अधिकतम प्रयास करना): Refers to putting in extraordinary effort to achieve something. • **Example:** He made a supreme effort to finish the marathon despite his injury. 1c7:T984, The correct answer is** option 2.**
